zh.explain: 财富虽多却在梦中，名声虽高并不真实。太遥远的东西难以确定其真实性，只有贵人指点后才能笑逐颜开。
divination: 像在梦中说梦一样，不要期待什么声名。
若想有一个好的结果，应当让贵人给予指点和帮助。
items: 到达目的地的时间延迟
zh.summary: 此卦梦中得宝之象。所祈求之事是虚假的成分多，实在的成分少。

verse: Much wealth you have in your dreams,
What’s in a name but an empty word.
Things found beyond seas and mountains hard to be real,
Only help from a patron will put a smile on your face.
interpretation: Dreams are dreams, do not hanker after fame.
Wait for the right moment when your distinguished patron will guide you.
meaning: many things are not what they appear to be.
en.explain: Although wealth is abundant it is present only in dreams. Although reputation is high, it is not real. It is very difficult to ascertain the authenticity of things far away, only guidance from a benefactor can put a smile on your face.
divination: Like talking in a dream, do not have too much expectation on fame.
If you wish to have a good outcome, you must be ready to accept guidance and assistance from a benefactor.
items: Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Not so smooth, work harder to do good, pray for blessings
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' (18 items). en uses 'Traveller'.
